# The Citizen

> Local news and community information for Peachtree City and Fayetteville, Georgia.

The Citizen is a digital news platform dedicated to covering local news, events, and community updates for residents of Peachtree City and Fayetteville. The site maintains an archive of news content and serves as a primary information source for these Georgia communities.

## Key Topics

- The Citizen
- Peachtree City
- Fayetteville
- Local News
- Community
- Cal Beverly
- Georgia
- Archive
- News Coverage
- Regional Updates
